As they search for a way to get back to civilisation, it becomes clear that they are not alone. Comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Jenny Slate, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney

programme.title: The Bad Guys 2
programme.desc: [AD] Struggling to adjust to their newly minted lives as Good Guys, the Bad Guys are offered one last job by a group of all-female criminals. Animated sequel, featuring the voices of Sam Rockwell, Marc Maron and Craig Robinson

programme.title: The Pirates! In an Adventure with Scientists!
programme.sub-title: The Pirates! In an Adventure with Scientists!
programme.desc: The bungling leader of a band of inept buccaneers is determined to prove his worth to his rivals and win the coveted Pirate of the Year award. An encounter with the naturalist Charles Darwin gives him the chance to pull off a daring crime - if he can survive coming face to face with the pirate-hating Queen Victoria. Animated comedy, with the voices of Hugh Grant, Martin Freeman, Imelda Staunton and David Tennant

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A pig who works as a bounty hunter finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Animated comedy, with the voices of Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: [AD] A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: [AD] Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: Victor Frankenstein
programme.desc: A sideshow performer is taken in by a scientist, who seeks his help in performing experiments to create life, and hopefully uncover the secrets of immortality. The plan goes dangerously out of control, and it falls to the devoted assistant to save his master from his dark obsessions and his monstrous creation. Gothic horror, starring James McAvoy and Daniel Radcliffe

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
programme.sub-title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
programme.desc: Lucy and Edmund Pevensie return to the magical world accompanied by their selfish cousin. They join their old friend King Caspian as he sets sail across the sea in search of seven of his father's allies who had been banished years before, but along the way they discover an evil force is growing in strength. Fantasy adventure, with Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Will Poulter and Ben Barnes

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois

programme.title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua
programme.desc: A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Palaeontologist Dr Alan Grant is lured to a dinosaur-infested island by a divorced couple who offer to fund his research, unaware their real motive is to find their missing son - and that the creatures on the island are far more intelligent than anyone suspected. Action adventure sequel, starring Sam Neill, William H Macy, Tea Leoni and Alessandro Nivola

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: The American secretary of defence forms a covert military organisation with the intention of assassinating the president. A government spymaster is ready to foil the plot but, since his top agent is dead, he has to recruit an imprisoned soldier to help him. Action sequel, starring Ice Cube, Samuel L Jackson and Willem Dafoe

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: A disgraced former cop is arrested by the FBI for illegal street racing, but his one-time colleagues offer him freedom in exchange for going on an undercover mission. Teaming up with an old racing friend and a customs official, he has to infiltrate and bring down a drug-trafficking operation. Thriller sequel, with Paul Walker reprising his role from The Fast and the Furious alongside Tyrese Gibson, Eva Mendes and Cole Hauser

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: [AD] Scientist Dr Ian Malcolm reluctantly joins a research team on the island where his employer first designed genetically engineered dinosaurs. Meanwhile, a big-game hunter takes the chance to bag the biggest prize of all - a Tyrannosaurus rex. Steven Spielberg's dinosaur adventure sequel, starring Jeff Goldblum, Julianne Moore, Pete Postlethwaite and Richard Attenborough

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Creepy couple Morticia and Gomez find their unconventional life threatened by a man claiming to be a long-lost relative. When they welcome him with open arms, they fall prey to a plot that could cost them their ancestral home and the family fortune. Black comedy based on the 1960s TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd, Christina Ricci, Jimmy Workman and Carel Struycken

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Spooky couple Gomez and Morticia hire a nanny to look after their new baby son - and stop him suffering an early death at the hands of his jealous elder siblings. Romance soon blossoms between the new childminder and Uncle Fester, but he does not realise she is planning to kill him once she has got hold of the family fortune. Comedy sequel, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd, Christina Ricci and Joan Cusack

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: A mysterious, planet-sized energy cloud is heading for Earth, destroying everything in its path. Admiral James T Kirk returns to the bridge of the Enterprise to stop the invader, but he has to contend with a bitter rival and the possession of one of his crew by the alien force. Sci-fi adventure, the first movie based on the TV series, starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley and Persis Khambatta

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.sub-title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: [AD] The Enterprise crew faces a bitter battle to the death with an old enemy. Khan, a genetically engineered superhuman tyrant, has escaped exile on a barren planet and hijacked a starship to take his revenge on Admiral Kirk, while also scheming to turn an experimental planet-creating device into a doomsday weapon. Sci-fi adventure sequel, with William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Ricardo Montalban and Kirstie Alley

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A writer struggling to complete the script for a movie about psychopathic killers turns to his criminal friends for advice. He ends up getting more than he bargained for when the small-time crooks kidnap a dog that belongs to a gangster, putting all their lives in danger. Comedy thriller, starring Colin Farrell, Sam Rockwell, Christopher Walken and Woody Harrelson

programme.title: Grimsby
programme.desc: [AD] Two brothers are separated at birth, the younger growing up to be MI6's top agent while the older becomes a layabout football hooligan. When they are finally reunited, the dim-witted elder sibling ends up helping his brother foil an evil plan that threatens the entire world. Action comedy, starring Sacha Baron Cohen, Mark Strong and Rebel Wilson

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: [AD] Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: A failed rock star carves out a career as a popular wedding singer, but his hopes for a bright future are dashed when his fiancee jilts him at the altar and he tries to shut himself off from the outside world. At one of his functions, a waitress catches his eye - but unfortunately for him, she is already engaged to someone else. Romantic comedy set in the 1980s, starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Sadistic young gang leader Alex leads a carefree life indulging his love of rape, violence and classical music. When he is finally arrested, he is subjected to a sinister form of aversion therapy that brainwashes him into being physically unable to use violence. However, on his release, he finds friends and family have turned on him, while others seek to exploit him to further their political ends. Drama, starring Malcolm McDowell and Warren Clarke

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: The world's tallest building goes up in flames during the opening celebrations. While Doug Roberts, the architect who designed the skyscraper, tries to save the party-goers trapped on the 135th floor, fire chief Michael O'Hallorhan leads a valiant attempt to fight the blaze. Irwin Allen and John Guillermin shared directing duties on this triple Oscar-winning disaster epic with an all-star cast including Paul Newman, Steve McQueen, Faye Dunaway, William Holden, Fred Astaire, Richard Chamberlain, Susan Blakely and Robert Vaughn

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: A police forensic psychologist searches for the daughter of a senator, who has been kidnapped from her expensive private school by a media-obsessed teacher, sparking a desperate race to hunt down her psychotic and devilishly intelligent captor before it is too late. Thriller prequel to Kiss the Girls, starring Morgan Freeman, Monica Potter, Michael Wincott, Dylan Baker and Penelope Ann Miller

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Having lost her job and her husband, alcoholic Rachel Watson spends time aimlessly travelling on a train. She gets drawn into a web of intrigue when she becomes fascinated by a woman's disappearance. Rachel thinks she has vital evidence in cracking the case, but gaps in her memory cloud her judgment, and before long her own life is endangered. Thriller based on Paula Hawkins' novel, starring Emily Blunt, Rebecca Ferguson, Haley Bennett, Justin Theroux and Luke Evans

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: A farmer is murdered by a hired hand, who flees into the wilderness. The dead man's strong-willed 14-year-old daughter is determined to bring the killer to justice, and recruits the aid of a hard-drinking, one-eyed marshal to help her track him down. The Coen brothers' Western based on Charles Portis' novel, with Jeff Bridges, Hailee Steinfeld, Matt Damon and Josh Brolin

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: A lonely 11-year-old tomboy feels responsible for her mother's death, but a boy's friendship helps her get through her emotional problems. Meanwhile, when she realises her father is falling in love with his new employee, she sets out to do all she can to end the romance. Drama, starring Anna Chlumsky, Macaulay Culkin, Dan Aykroyd and Jamie Lee Curtis

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: [AD] Allied PoWs take to the football field when a group of Nazi officers comes up with the idea to have them take on a German team for a propaganda event. However, the prisoners see a chance to escape during the match. Second World War adventure, with Michael Caine, Sylvester Stallone, Max von Sydow and Daniel Massey. Soccer legends also making appearances include Pele, Bobby Moore and Ossie Ardiles

programme.title: Regretting You
programme.desc: A mother and daughter grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to rediscover themselves. Romantic comedy drama, starring Allison Williams, Mckenna Grace and Dave Franco

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: [AD] A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Five medical students conduct dangerous experiments to discover whether there is an afterlife by electronically inducing a near-deathlike state and then bringing about resuscitation at the critical moment. However, when they venture into real-death experiences, they unwittingly unleash supernatural phenomena linked to their past misdeeds. Thriller, with Julia Roberts, Kiefer Sutherland, Kevin Bacon, William Baldwin and Oliver Platt

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: The nomadic warrior pitches up in the city of a cut-throat desert community in search of his stolen vehicle and ends up making a deal with a local dictator to get rid of her rival for power. However, when the bargain turns sour, he is cast out into the wilderness - where he becomes the unlikely protector of a tribe of feral youngsters. Sci-fi adventure sequel, starring Mel Gibson, Tina Turner and Bruce Spence

And he meets a man who thinks he has discovered the next superfood, which Rick used to cook up a delicious duck dish

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall

After a wild swim at one of Cornwall's picturesque hidden coves, Rick cooks a simple sea bass recipe, revealing how to make the perfect mayonnaise. In the far west of the county, on the Land's End peninsula, Rick meets his niece, a modern artist, who explains her deep spiritual connection to Cornwall

programme.title: Death on the Beach

programme.sub-title: 24 Hours in Police Custody: A Family Vendetta
programme.desc: [AD] Part one of a two-part special. Police receive a 999 call to an address in the quiet Cambridgeshire village of Bluntisham after a man has been fatally shot. Detectives establish that the motive for the double murder could lie in a dispute over who should have custody of the child of the first victim

programme.desc: [AD] The return of the documentary series that follows the investigations of specialist units within UK police forces created to crack the toughest of cases, from cyber heists, romance fraud and people trafficking to drug rings and murder. With access to some of Britain’s most talented detectives, the series explores the investigations, methods and evidence that has put some of the UK’s most dangerous criminals behind bars. Each episode features 'evidential police footage' as they take on criminals and hunt for clues to solve the cases. The series offers a first-hand experience of the work of the elite units on the front line while witnessing their bravery, skill and compassion amid tragedy and loss. The series also discovers how detectives operate in the interview room, how forensics bring a case into focus, and how expert CCTV and digital analysis create timelines and evidence to catch a criminal, and the impact these crimes have on the communities they serve. programme.desc: A mischievous trio of talking chipmunks invade a struggling songwriter's home. When the furry critters demonstrate a remarkable talent for singing, he agrees to help them find fame and fortune. However, an unscrupulous record company boss has other plans. Children's comedy, starring Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.sub-title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: [AD] The singing trio are left in the care of their manager's nephew and try to save a school's music programme by winning a battle-of-the-bands competition. However, they encounter fierce rivalry from another group of musical rodents. Comedy, starring Zachary Levi, Jason Lee and David Cross, with the voices of Justin Long and Christina Applegate

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: The singing rodents cause mayhem while performing on a tropical cruise, before they find themselves stranded on a desert island. As they search for a way to get back to civilisation, it becomes clear that they are not alone. Comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Jenny Slate, with the voices of Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler and Jesse McCartney

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: [AD] Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: A headstrong chicken and her fellow fowls ponder how to escape from a grim Yorkshire farm before the evil farmer's wife can turn them into pies. Luckily, help arrives in the form of a heroic American rooster who promises to show them how to fly. Nick Park's animated comedy, with the voices of Mel Gibson, Julia Sawalha, Miranda Richardson and Jane Horrocks

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Tommy tries to return his new brother to the baby shop, helped by Angelica, Chuckie, Phil and Lil - but the friends become lost in dense woodlands en route, turning their expedition into a scary and exciting journey of discovery. Animated comedy based on the TV series, with the voices of Elizabeth Daily, Christine Cavanaugh, Kath Soucie, Whoopi Goldberg and Busta Rhymes

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois

programme.title: Planes
programme.desc: A crop duster longs to be a racing plane, but is hamstrung by a fear of heights. With the aid of a veteran flyer, he learns to conquer his phobia and compete against some of the world's greatest flyers in a round-the-world race. Animated adventure spin-off from Pixar's Cars, with the voices of Dane Cook, Teri Hatcher and Stacy Keach

programme.title: Hannah Montana: The Movie
programme.desc: As her pop starlet alter-ego Hannah Montana's fame begins to grow, teenager Miley Stewart gets carried away with the success and is sent to work on the family farm in Tennessee. With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: A haunted special forces soldier returns to London from Afghanistan and assumes another man's identity, hoping to make a fresh start. He is drawn into the city's criminal underworld, where his skills prove valuable to the highest bidder, and plots revenge against the gangster who killed his girlfriend. Crime thriller, with Jason Statham and Agata Buzek

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: [AD] Detectives Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett search for a $100million heroin consignment brazenly stolen by a French drug kingpin from the police evidence room. However, after a mix-up over a phone call from a potential witness, each cop has to assume the other's identity - Lowrey becoming the henpecked family man and Burnett the playboy. Michael Bay's action thriller, starring Will Smith, Martin Lawrence, Tea Leoni, Tcheky Karyo and Theresa Randle

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.sub-title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: The Starship Enterprise races to the rescue of intergalactic ambassadors held hostage on a distant planet. The crisis proves to be the handiwork of a renegade Vulcan mystic who kidnaps Captain Kirk and his crew, ordering them to fly to an unexplored world where he hopes to fulfil his insane ambition - to meet God. Sci-fi adventure, written, directed by and starring William Shatner, with Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley and David Warner

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.sub-title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Captain Kirk is framed for the assassination of the Klingon head of state just as the Federation is about to make peace with their old enemies. As Kirk and Dr McCoy are banished to an icy prison planet, Spock tries to uncover the identity of the real killers. Sci-fi adventure sequel, with William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, Iman, and Christopher Plummer, with appearances by Christian Slater, and Michael Dorn from Star Trek: The Next Generation

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: An overweight high-school student is madly in love with his best friend, but their feelings are far from mutual. Years later, having slimmed down and become a successful music executive, he resolves to put an end to his unrequited love and finally win her over. Romantic comedy, starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart, Anna Faris and Chris Klein

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A writer struggling to complete the script for a movie about psychopathic killers turns to his criminal friends for advice. Comedy thriller, starring Colin Farrell, Sam Rockwell, Christopher Walken and Woody Harrelson

programme.title: Strung
programme.desc: A talented violinist whose new job tutoring for an elite family turns into a battle for safety and sanity when she realises her past is linked to the family's patriarch. Thriller, starring Chloe Bailey, Lynn Whitfield and Lucien Laviscount

programme.title: Carolina Caroline

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.sub-title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: [AD] Bruno, a boy in Nazi Germany, moves to the country when his father is placed in charge of a concentration camp. Drama, starring David Thewlis, Asa Butterfield and Jack Scanlon

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: [AD] Catherine Earnshaw is raised by her alcoholic father at a Yorkshire farmhouse, with Nelly Dean as a constant companion. Writer-director Emerald Fennell's drama based on Emily Bronte's romance, starring Margot Robbie, Jacob Elordi and Martin Clunes

Danny Boyle's horror thriller sequel, starring Jodie Comer, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Ralph Fiennes and Rocco Haynes

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Leanne, Jenny, Louise and Lauralee compete for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: [AD] Liz explores the natural wonders of the region and its remarkable ecosystems, encountering its wildlife and meeting inspiring local conservationists. She begins in the Greater Antilles, where people are learning to forge a new relationship with the animals that inhabit this wild terrain. On the island of Hispaniola in the Dominican Republic, she helps residents of the tiny village of Los Limones scale a 60ft palm tree to retrieve a Ridgeway's hawk chick at risk of a deadly parasitic infection

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Edith Bowman and Colin Murray explore the Nairn Show to find tips and treats among the food stalls, including how to spot the perfect egg and how to choose the juiciest berries. Baker Briony-May Williams discovers bargains when using an app designed to reduce food waste, farmer Meinir Howells gets to grips with turning rapeseed into oil in Rhuthin, and chef Suzie Lee finds out whether there's such a thing as a healthy bacon sandwich.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: [AD] Michael Portillo heads from Newcastle to Lynemouth, and is intrigued to hear of its part in Newcastle's early industrial development. En route, Michael travels through the huge Northumberland coalfield and, at Cramlington, he alights to visit an extraordinary work of landform art made from the spoil of a coalmine, the vast Northumberlandia, known as the Lady of the North

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: [AD] Liz explores the natural wonders of the region and its remarkable ecosystems, encountering its wildlife and meeting inspiring local conservationists. On the island of Hispaniola in the Dominican Republic, she helps residents of the tiny village of Los Limones scale a 60ft palm tree to retrieve a Ridgeway's hawk chick at risk of a deadly parasitic infection

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz, which sees contestants Laura, Olu, Jack, Jane and Luke race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team travel to Sydney, Australia, to value artefacts and rarities on the other side of the world. Among items brought in are part of the keel of Captain Cook's ship Endeavour, furniture made by convicts transported to the country during the 18th century, and a collection of opera star Maria Callas memorabilia - which receives one of the highest valuations ever given on the programme

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Join Stephen Mulhern as Sylvia is given his opportunity to open the iconic red boxes. But will he be tempted to accept an offer from the Banker in exchange for what might be inside his box? Or will he hold out until the end and be rewarded with the £100,000 jackpot?

programme.title: Help! We Bought a Village
programme.desc: A demolition team are onsite at John and Tara's Portuguese quinta, and the couple discover an amazing connection between their builder and the house he's knocking down. In Italy, Cesidio welcomes his daughter and her family to the village. And in France, Liz and Dave need help after a storm brings down the wall of one of their cottages

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: [AD] Six prisoners escape and scatter across the city after an explosion at a fruit-packing plant and Hondo and Squad 20 pursue them, discovering that the incident was no accident and that the fugitives sare working together to carry out a high-stakes robbery. Commander Hicks packs up his office as he prepares to vacate the commander's post, and Gamble gets sobering news about her jailed father

programme.title: Nothing to Declare
programme.desc: Another edition of the fly-on-the-wall documentary accessing the world of national security at Australia's biggest airports, following customs and immigration officers as they go about their daily business of tackling drug runners, illegal immigrants and terrorists

programme.title: Nothing to Declare
programme.desc: Another edition of the fly-on-the-wall documentary accessing the world of national security at Australia's biggest airports, following customs and immigration officers as they go about their daily business of tackling drug runners, illegal immigrants and terrorists

programme.title: Billions
programme.desc: [AD] Axe receives a tip about a mole inside his company, throwing the US Attorney's case into jeopardy. Later, a secret from his past surfaces. Paul Giamatti and Damian Lewis star

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: [AD] A missing woman staggers into the police station, claiming a creature is 'trying to get out'. That night her father panics as he sees an alien shape through the window. The next day his body is found in a locked room and Father Brown suspects he has been poisoned. Such events prompt local speculation to mount that Kembleford is under threat of an alien invasion. Mark Williams stars

programme.title: Last of the Summer Wine
programme.sub-title: Here We Go Again into the Wild Blue Yonder
programme.desc: Part two of two. Wally finishes the hang-glider and declares that it is ready to be tested, so Compo steps into the fray. Long-running comedy set in rural Yorkshire, starring Bill Owen and Kathy Staff

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick visits Tintagel, Cornwall's most mythical place, which was an important trading port with Europe and the birthplace of perhaps Britain's greatest legend - the tale of King Arthur. He also learns how the Methodists were important to Cornwall, and how they would cook a rather unusual bun during feast days, and meets a family on the Roseland Peninsula who are continuing the surprisingly ancient tradition of growing an exotic spice - saffron

programme.title: Rick Stein's Cornwall
programme.desc: Rick explores the rich and diverse history of West Penwith, the farthest point west in mainland Britain. He visits Lamorna Cove, made famous through song and art, and the Unesco-protected tin and copper mining area of Botallack, where he talks to a mining explorer. The chef also follows an ancient track in search of Cornwall's oldest building and reveals how, as a young lad on the Lizard Peninsula, he fell in love for the first time and tasted his first French fish stew - known as a bouillabaisse

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: [AD] Everyone except Ross pools their money to buy lottery tickets, but a disagreement about how to spend any winnings prompts a disdainful Phoebe to make a rash gesture. Chandler frets as he waits for a phone call that could mean a new job, and Rachel thinks Emma is close to saying her first word

programme.title: Prue and Sandi's South African Adventure
programme.desc: Long-term friends Prue Leith and Sandi Toksvig explore Prue's beloved homeland of South Africa. They start out in Cape Town, where the former Bake Off judge was born and where she lived as a university student. Delving into the city's rich culture and landscapes, the pair take a cable car ride to the top of Table Mountain, enjoy a beachside barbecue - or braai - with an old family friend and visit District Six, where they learn how 60,000 people were uprooted from their homes during Apartheid

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off: Second Helpings
programme.desc: [AD] Jon Richardson and Judi Love host the companion programme, in which they and their guests look back at the highlights of the Bake Off final. They celebrate the standout moments and serve up their take on the episode's biggest talking points and best bakes

programme.title: Forensics: Murder Scene
programme.desc: Examining the case of a man who was left for dead on a street in Swansea in broad daylight after being stabbed in the throat. Witnesses report seeing two men quickly fleeing the scene. Paramedics arrive and immediately begin trying to save the man's life. Officers use CCTV to search for the two suspects, but as police began their hunt, the victim dies

programme.title: Forensics: Murder Scene
programme.desc: Two men, who were meant to be friends of the victim, have been arrested and are refusing to talk. Forensics are working hard at the scene and discover items that are directly related to the attack - a broken, blood-covered bottle has traces of DNA that links all three men. In custody, one of the men makes a part-confession to a nurse, but refuses to elaborate

programme.title: When Evil Came to Rochdale
programme.desc: In 1990, six families in Rochdale were accused by social service workers of being involved in the satanic ritual abuse of children. Multiple youngsters were taken into care, placed into foster homes and barred from all contact with their families. For some it would be an unbearably long time before they saw their parents again. This documentary uses the scandal as a starting point to explore infamous Satanic panic cases, a type of moral hysteria fuelled by overzealous law enforcement, unsubstantiated statements from children and suggestive interrogation by therapists and prosecutors

His case is taken up by New Mexico lawyer Nancy Hollander, who is determined to take the US government to task for unlawful detention. Fact-based legal drama, starring Tahar Rahim, Jodie Foster, Shailene Woodley and Benedict Cumberbatch

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef

programme.title: Cold Case Forensics: The Death of God's Banker
programme.desc: [AD] Return of the documentary delving into the casebook of world-leading forensic scientist Angela Gallop and her team. Nicola Walker narrates

programme.title: Police 999: Clear & Present Danger
programme.desc: A dangerous criminal is on the run and a stop and search puts an officer's life at risk. On the outskirts of Birmingham, an officer engages in dialogue with a suspicious man that leads to a physical altercation involving a moving car

programme.title: Task

Following his brother's death, Robbie Prendergrast earns extra cash for his family by ripping off drug dealers - but a bad tip upends his delicate balance. Crime drama, starring Mark Ruffalo

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: [AD] A missing woman staggers into the police station, claiming a creature is 'trying to get out'. That night her father panics as he sees an alien shape through the window. Mark Williams stars

programme.title: Two Doors Down
programme.desc: [AD] When Eric raids the freezer, he leaves the door open and all the food inside thaws out, so his better half Beth throws an impromptu party for friends Cathy, Colin, Ian, Jaz, Christine and Sophie to consume the food before it goes to waste. Everything goes well until Cathy urges Colin to go next door and get something out of their freezer to replace the defrosted food - a whole Scottish salmon. First episode of the sitcom exploring the best and worst of suburban family life, starring Arabella Weir, Alex Norton, Doon Mackichan, Jonathan Watson, Elaine C Smith and Sharon Rooney

programme.title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science

programme.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby

Comedy, starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen

programme.title: Strung

Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley

Animated comedy, with the voices of Sandra Bullock, Pierre Coffin, Jon Hamm and Michael Keaton

Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline

Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage

Thriller, starring Samuel L Jackson, Julianna Margulies and Jonathan Phillips

Sci-fi action adventure sequel, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Linda Hamilton, Edward Furlong and Robert Patrick

programme.title: Autumnwatch: Autumn Calm
programme.desc: A welcome return for an audience favourite - Autumnwatch's Mindfulness Moments. This is an opportunity to switch off from the stresses of our busy lives and immerse ourselves in pure nature. No music, no presenter voice-over, just natural sound and glorious pictures to take us to the most stunning places in this most colourful of seasons

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Jules Hudson meets a couple who have spent a few decades in Australia, but have decided to swap the surf and sunshine for the lovely views and charm of Cornwall. He also visits an abandoned slate quarry that has been transformed into an extraordinary off-grid retreat, full of creativity and coastal magic

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.sub-title: Glasgow - A Fix at the Top of the Cathedral
programme.desc: [AD] Dominic Chinea and Lucia Scalisi help repair Glasgow Cathedral's weathervane at the top of the 225ft spire, save a Chinese unicorn mask made of bamboo and paper that plays and important part in celebrations for Glasgow's Hakka Chinese Community, and discover how street art is changing the city

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: [AD] Michael Portillo explores the wild and rugged coastline of Northumberland by rail, beginning in Morpeth, where he finds an historic collection of Northumbrian bagpipes and discovers how difficult they are to play. The East Coast mainline delivers Michael to Widdrington and its long sandy bay, where a beachcombing blacksmith finds treasures to inspire artwork in steel

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: [AD] Liz heads to Belize as she explores the Central American coastline, which supports an extraordinary array of wildlife and is home to some of the world's most endangered animals. With a scientist in Cockscomb Reserve, Liz goes on the trail of a jaguar that's suspected of taking local pigs, and helps a small Mayan village ward off future attacks. Travelling on to Costa Rica, Liz meets a man who turned his father's farm into a haven for frogs that is now home to 29 species - from the blue jean strawberry dart frog to the red-eyed tree frog and ghost frog

programme.title: Lingo
programme.desc: Gerard and Maxine from Doncaster, Sam and Ellie from Newbury, and Chris and her daughter Sally from Hull use their powers of deduction to work out words that appear in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords. Adil Ray hosts

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Laura Hamilton meets Vicky and Tom, who are taking early retirement and planning to make a permanent move to the coastal town of Lagos on Portugal's Algarve. With their budget of £235,000 they want a modern two-bed open-plan property. Laura shows them five options to consider

programme.title: Wrapped Up in Christmas
programme.desc: A mall manager is given the task of cancelling the leases of underperforming stores at Christmas, but she soon finds herself falling for the nephew of a shop owner as he helps his aunt try to make it through the holidays. Festive drama, starring Tatyana Ali and Brendan Fehr

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: [AD] When Hondo's ne'er-do-well cousin Andre goes Awol from his Marine base during basic training, he, Deacon and Daniel Sr take a road trip to get him in line. They learn that Andre witnessed an illegal arms deal involving stolen military weapons, and Hondo realises there's a darker explanation for his disappearance

programme.title: Caught on Dashcam
programme.desc: Fly-on-the-dashboard documentary showcasing outrageous road disasters, captured in video form by drivers' in-vehicle dashboard cameras

programme.title: Billions
programme.desc: [AD] A sudden and mysterious disappearance sends both Axe and Chuck spinning, before Connerty, Chuck and the FBI go on a manhunt

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: The sudden death of a key witness in a case leaves Murdoch physically unsettled

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Hyacinth and Richard take over a country cottage for a couple of days, with unexpected results. Comedy, starring Patricia Routledge and Clive Swift

programme.title: Last of the Summer Wine
programme.desc: Clegg and Compo discover Foggy thinks they should devote themselves to first aid, after a life-saving attempt ends in a drenching

programme.title: Speed with Guy Martin
programme.desc: The motorbike racer takes part in four more speed-based challenges and gets his hands dirty in unique engineering projects to discover what makes things go fast. In the first programme, he finds out how far it's possible to travel on a bicycle during 24 hours of non-stop pedalling. With the help of bike experts Miles Kingsbury and Mike Burrows he builds a tandem, and pairs up with his friend, endurance expert Jason Miles, to see how far they can push their bodies. In the build-up to the final record attempt at the historic Goodwood Motor Circuit, Guy also learns about the science of cooking for athletes with nutritionist Nigel Mitchell, who instructs him to lose five kilos and recommends a new diet regimen

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One After Joey and Rachel Kiss
programme.desc: [AD] Rachel and Joey struggle to find the words to tell Ross about their kiss in Barbados, while Phoebe makes the alarming discovery that Mike has a girlfriend. Starring Jennifer Aniston, Matt LeBlanc and Lisa Kudrow

programme.title: Will & Grace
programme.desc: [AD] Will and Jack visit a couple of old friends who used to have a reputation for their wild parties - but are shocked to discover they have decided to settle down and raise an adopted child. Grace makes fun of Karen, who is apparently jealous of her relationship with Ben

programme.title: Will & Grace
programme.desc: [AD] Karen corrupts Grace's new intern, while Will and Jack are accused of sexism by two lesbians at a gay sensitivity seminar. Comedy, starring Eric McCormack and Debra Messing

programme.title: The Only Way Is Essex
programme.desc: The Vietnam trip may be over, but the fallout is only just beginning. Resentment still lingers among the group, and a shocking revelation stops Elma in her tracks.

programme.title: Classic Emmerdale
programme.desc: [AD] Nicola and Jimmy tell Carl he must take some blame for the accident. Val is cut off by Pollard and Diane, and Gennie tires of being caught in the crossfire between Viv and Brenda.

programme.title: The Prisoner
programme.desc: Number Six faces a threat to his sanity in the midst of a masked ball, where he meets Peter Pan and Little Bo Peep and finds himself being placed on trial for making an audacious bid to foil his captors. Cult drama, starring Patrick McGoohan

programme.title: Killer in My Village
programme.desc: How a bitter divorce acted as the catalyst for a horrific murder carried out by an estranged wife and her lover

programme.title: The Eighties
programme.desc: [AD] A look at the events of Ronald Reagan's two terms in the White House, examining landmark legislative achievements as well as political setbacks

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The Vegas ladies discover that one of them has Texas flair. Kenny lucks out looking for 'lady stuff', while Mary gets the spring back in her step

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: In West Covina, Rene brings Gunter for moral support, but gets annoyed when the older German refuses to take sides. Darrell stumbles over what may be a diamond in the rough, while Brandi and Jarrod discover a different national pastime

programme.title: Great Blue Wild
programme.desc: Across the 3,000 scattered islands of the Bahamas lie incredible natural wonders, from giant pine forests to secret labyrinths of underwater caves

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: Investigating how one of the slipperiest substances known to man is used to make waterproof clothing for explorers, mountaineers and special forces soldiers

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How oranges are turned into marmalade, and a look at how dresses are printed, fit for the catwalk

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: A $4,500 birthday gift to a teenager is hastily spent to buy a used BMW; the teen's grandfather claims a man illegally sold the car to the boy and sues for damages

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: An obscenity is sprayed in hair mousse on a car after a young woman has a fight with her friend after she was stranded at a nightclub; she is sued for vandalism

programme.title: Impractical Jokers
programme.desc: Hidden camera practical joke show featuring the escapades of Joe, Sal, Murr and Q from comedy troupe the Tenderloins

programme.title: Impractical Jokers
programme.desc: Find out whether the guys can make it as film directors. Celebrity guest Paula Abdul hosts a dinner for her fans, and least successful prankster is in attendance.

programme.title: Police Interceptors

programme.title: America's Last Slave Ship: Drain the Oceans

Each question is against the clock and if a player gets one wrong they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place

programme.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for £1 million - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: The Middle
programme.desc: Following years of being at their children's beck and call, Frankie and Mike decide enough is enough, and that the time is right to regain control of the Heck household. However, Axl, Sue and Brick refuse to give up without a fight

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.sub-title: The Yips and an Oddly Hypnotic Bohemian
programme.desc: George Sr plays handyman at Brenda Sparks' house, while Sheldon gets the science yips and has to learn not to think

programme.title: Hydref Gwyllt Iolo
programme.desc: On the uplands and conifer woodlands, Iolo Williams finds red squirrels, wild goats, deer, hares and a bird with an amazing bill for opening pine cones

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: [AD] Phil gets ready to play in a charity basketball match, but NBA stars Charles Barkley and DeAndre Jordan show up and the pressure gets too much for him

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: [AD] During a quick workout session in the garage, Mitchell accidentally knocks over an urn filled with the ashes of Cam's beloved pet pig Lilly and quickly attempts to cover up his blunder. Hoping to catch Mitchell in a lie, Cam makes up a tall tale to trap him, but his own web of deceit soon becomes a little too big to manage

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Laurence and Danny Bowes welcome their guests to the Leicester Arms in Penshurst, Kent, and while some get a spotless welcome, Jackie and Nigel make a few dirty discoveries

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The fourth visit of the week is to Weston-super-Mare in Somerset and Oakover Guesthouse, owned by former banker Simon Robinson and partner Ann Wilson. Most guests are delighted by the décor, but Lucy and Ruth get a frosty reception. In the afternoon, some guests reveal their competitive side with all the fun of the fair. But come morning, Jackie and Nigel's noses are put out of joint as a bad smell disturbed their sleep. During feedback some feathers are ruffled

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: [AD] The competition heads to Milton Keynes, where first to host is 52-year old hypnotherapist Howard, who is hoping his fancy menu will go down with his guests. However, with dishes including 'red treacle tart' his visitors are unsure what to expect, and not everyone shares the thrill when Howard introduces his 'Pendulum of Truth' to the proceedings

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

At first his fantastic skills delight him, but his elation is severely tempered by a family tragedy, prompting him to dedicate his talents to combating evil. However, he faces a baptism of fire in the form of crazed villain the Green Goblin. Comic-book superhero adventure, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Willem Dafoe, James Franco and Rosemary Harris

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: [AD] Peter Parker continues his fight for justice, but unrequited love and personal worries take their toll and he is tempted to abandon his web-slinging alter ego. However, the arrival of deadly new bad guy Doctor Octopus plunges him into a race against time to save New York. Comic-book adventure sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, Alfred Molina, James Franco and Rosemary Harris

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: [AD] Dracula is worried that his half-human grandson is not showing any vampiric tendencies, so enlists the help of his fellow monsters in showing the youngster how it is done. The count is shocked to receive an unwelcome visit from his own father, who does not approve of his son's tolerance of humans. Animated comedy, with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Count Dracula and company participate in a cruise for sea-loving monsters, unaware that their boat is being commandeered by the monster-hating Van Helsing family. Animated sequel, featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: A lonely little girl befriends a runaway alien that helps mend her fractured family. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Maia Kealoha and Sydney Agudong

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: A ruthless warlord resolves to rid the desert of its few remaining tribes, prompting them to seek the help of a legendary assassin to end the despot's reign of terror by destroying his source of power - a beautiful but deadly sorceress. Fantasy action adventure, starring Dwayne Johnson, Steven Brand, Kelly Hu and Michael Clarke Duncan

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: [AD] A cocky test pilot is given a mysterious ring by a dying alien and transported to another world, where he learns he has been recruited into a galactic peacekeeping organisation. He trains to use the incredible powers the ring grants him, and returns to Earth to defend it from a powerful force that feeds on fear. Sci-fi adventure, starring Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Peter Sarsgaard and Mark Strong

programme.title: The Wizard of Oz
programme.desc: [AD] Youngster Dorothy Gale is whisked over the rainbow by a tornado into the magical land of Oz, where she inadvertently kills a wicked witch - incurring the wrath of another. Setting out to find the wizard who can show her a way home, she is joined on her journey by a scarecrow, a tin man and a cowardly lion, who all hope their own wishes will be granted. Musical fantasy, with Judy Garland, Ray Bolger, Jack Haley, Bert Lahr and Frank Morgan

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: [AD] A kindly farmer wins a cute piglet, which some greedy humans and jealous animals hope will end up as the Christmas roast. Undaunted, the young pig proves himself useful on the farm and enlists the aid of the resident dog in learning how to herd sheep. Family comedy, starring James Cromwell and Magda Szubanski, with Christine Cavanaugh, Miriam Margolyes and Hugo Weaving among those providing the voices of the animal characters

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: A paranormal expert moves into a haunted house where his daughter befriends the amiable ghost of a young boy - but things start to go awry when three smelly spooks and two dastardly crooks try to chase the new residents away. Family comedy, starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Eric Idle, Cathy Moriarty and featuring the voice of Malachi Pearson

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: [AD] Dim-witted supermodels Derek Zoolander and Hansel McDonald must step back into the spotlight and save the day when a maniacal villain starts murdering some of the world's most beautiful pop stars. Comedy sequel, starring Ben Stiller and Owen Wilson, with Penelope Cruz, Will Ferrell and Kristen Wiig

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: An overweight high-school student is madly in love with his best friend, but their feelings are far from mutual. Years later, having slimmed down and become a successful music executive, he resolves to put an end to his unrequited love and finally win her over. Romantic comedy, starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart, Anna Faris and Chris Klein

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: Hungry
programme.desc: [AD] After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holiday-makers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose. Horror thriller, starring Madison Davenport and Tracey Bonner

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online and fall in love after the end of human civilisation. Award-winning drama written and directed by Sam Zuchero and Andrew Zuchero, starring Steven Yeun and Kristen Stewart

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: A retired army colonel has raised his three sons alone on their remote Montana ranch. But the all-male household is thrown into turmoil when the youngest son brings home his beautiful fiancee, causing jealousy and tensions that culminate in tragedy. Edward Zwick's period drama, starring Anthony Hopkins, Brad Pitt, Aidan Quinn, Julia Ormond and Henry Thomas

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Murderous alien beasties escape from their space prison and flee to Earth, where they wreak havoc in a sleepy Kansas village as they discover the delights of snacking on human flesh - and only two intergalactic bounty hunters look capable of saving the day. Madcap horror comedy, starring Dee Wallace Stone, M Emmet Walsh, Billy Green Bush and Scott Grimes

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: [AD] A convict facing execution is recruited for a secret experiment where his consciousness is sent back in time to experience the life of his ancestor - a 15th-century ancestor battling a secret society. With the same evil organisation plotting world domination in the present, he must master his predecessor's skills and unlock his secret knowledge to defeat them. Action adventure based on the video game series, starring Michael Fassbender, Marion Cotillard, Jeremy Irons and Brendan Gleeson

programme.title: A Carol For Two
programme.desc: A woman working in a diner with singing waiters gets the chance to perform in the venue's annual Christmas concert, attended by a number of big names on Broadway. However, the catch is that she will be dueting with a co-worker who has taken an instant dislike to her. Festive romance, starring Ginna Claire Mason and Jordan Litz

programme.title: A Grand Ole Opry Christmas
programme.desc: [AD] The daughter of a country star turns her back on music after her father's death, but is persuaded to face the past when she is invited to Nashville to represent him at a special Christmas celebration. Festive drama, starring Nikki DeLoach and Kristoffer Polaha

programme.title: Christmas in Wolf Creek
programme.desc: A woman and her boyfriend struggle to maintain their relationship, but when a reindeer threatens the annual Christmas play, the couple must work together to save Christmas for the town. Romantic comedy, starring Tim Rozon and Nola Martin

programme.title: 'Twas the Date Before Christmas
programme.desc: A woman creates a fake relationship for the sake of maintaining a family Christmas tradition. But as her family start to catch on to the deception, the man posing as her boyfriend begins to suspect another reason for their arrangement. Romantic drama, starring Amy Groening and Robert Buckley

Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.sub-title: Midlands - A Celestial Projector Is Brought Back to Life
programme.desc: [AD] Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

On neighbouring Union Island, Liz goes on patrol with an environmental army protecting the Union Island gecko, one of the smallest reptiles in the world and which was once one of the most trafficked reptiles in the Caribbean

programme.title: Lingo

They've holidayed in this part of the world many times and have decided now's the right time to buy their very own property. They have a maximum budget of £80,000, but can Danni hit the spot with any of the five fantastic properties she has lined up?

To learn the skills required in hill-climb events, Guy visits the birthplace of the sport - Shelsley Walsh in Worcestershire. Racing up the course in an F1-style car, he realises sheer horsepower and driving precision are vital, but he must also take a high-altitude fitness test in a hypoxic chamber to prepare for the challenge ahead

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton helps a couple who have never lived in an older home, but who are now ready to fall for a bit of period charm in either Norfolk or Suffolk. With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.sub-title: Midlands - A Celestial Projector Is Brought Back to Life
programme.desc: [AD] Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

programme.desc: Everyone in Fluffytown is gathered for a communal nap ahead of the big Siesta Fiesta Day celebration - because the better the nap, the better the party afterwards. Elder Chick demonstrates the Fluffytown nap timer and explains when she presses the button it's time to snooze, and when the hand reaches the balloon, it's time for the Siesta Fiesta. She starts the timer, and everyone hurries off to their nap stations to begin their naps. As the other Fluffytowners start to doze off, Love Monster struggles to fall asleep. After trying a pre-nap workout with Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny, practising yoga with Book Cub and pillow drumming with Bad Idea Puppy, a frustrated Love Monster gives up and thinks he might as well start getting ready for the party. He heads over to his decks and puts on a song just before the sleep timer goes off, and everyone awakes full of energy. As everyone boogies to the beats, Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny looks over to the decks, but Love Monster is nowhere to be seen. She goes around the back of the decks and finds him curled up underneath them, finally fast asleep. Sometimes, when you give up the struggle, you find the snuggle.

programme.sub-title: East Lothian - Saving the Musselburgh Carriage
programme.desc: [AD] Will Kirk and Kirsten Ramsay head to Musselburgh, on Scotland's east coast. It's a town boasting a proud heritage that is celebrated each year with a procession led by their elected Honest Lad and Honest Lass. However, for the past few years, the antique carriage these local luminaries ride in has been off the road. Restoring the carriage is a huge job that requires the skills of local signwriter Ross Hastie and wheelwright Greg Rowland, and made more complicated by the impending deadline of this year's festival. A musical instrument also needs some tender loving care and Will gets a makeover at Scotland's oldest bespoke tailors

programme.desc: [AD] Will Kirk and Kirsten Ramsay head to Musselburgh, on Scotland's east coast. Restoring the carriage is a huge job that requires the skills of local signwriter Ross Hastie and wheelwright Greg Rowland, and made more complicated by the impending deadline of this year's festival. A musical instrument also needs some tender loving care and Will gets a makeover at Scotland's oldest bespoke tailors

No music, no presenter voice-over, just natural sound and glorious pictures to take us to the most stunning places in this most colourful of seasons

programme.desc: A well-meaning angel is sent down to Earth to help a preacher in a poverty-stricken community who is losing his faith in the face of his life's challenges. However, the heavenly visitor forms a strong relationship with the churchman's wife. Remake of 1940s romantic fantasy The Bishop's Wife, starring Whitney Houston, Denzel Washington, Courtney B Vance, Justin Pierre Edmund and Lionel Richie

programme.title: Coriolanus
programme.desc: [AD] A feared general is manipulated by his scheming mother into pursuing a political career, but his failure to win public approval results in riots and his banishment. Furious at the society that has cast him aside, he allies with an old enemy to get revenge. Shakespearean drama, directed by and starring Ralph Fiennes, with Gerard Butler and Vanessa Redgrave

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Stephen Mangan hosts the game show, with Johnny and Kim joining captains Daisy May Cooper and Alan Carr to try to guess mystery passwords across multiple rounds as they try to win £10,000

programme.title: Bill Bailey: Cosmic Jam
programme.desc: In his classic debut live stand-up show, filmed at London's Bloomsbury Theatre in 1996, Bill explains why Bryan Adams is perhaps the greatest ever exponent of the rock anthem; demonstrates the influence that Cockney music has had on the great classical composers; and warns of the perils of a world ruled by insects, while playing the second-biggest gong in Britain

programme.title: Piers Morgan: Uncensored
programme.desc: News and debate hosted by Piers Morgan, blending journalism and cultural commentary

programme.title: The Rookie

programme.sub-title: Out Beyond Ideas of Wrongdoing and Rightdoing, There Is a River
programme.desc: [AD] The task force, Dark Hearts and Robbie converge in the woods, leading to a dramatic showdown with far-reaching consequences for all involved. In the aftermath, Tom turns his attention back to his now fragmented team as the FBI launches an investigation

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: [AD] The amateur sleuth struggles to protect those closest to him when an old foe is unexpectedly released from prison. Mark Williams stars

programme.title: The Good Life
programme.desc: Tom and Barbara apply their creative talents when they try to make clothes out of nettles and wool, while Jerry has his eye on becoming the next managing director of JJM. Comedy, starring Richard Briers, Felicity Kendal, Penelope Keith and Paul Eddington

programme.title: Blackadder II
programme.desc: [AD] Edmund receives a visit from the bloodthirsty Bishop of Bath and Wells, who threatens to do him a mischief with a red-hot poker over the matter of an unpaid loan. As he attempts to raise the £1,000 he needs, he finds himself being constantly summoned to the court by the Queen. Comedy, starring Rowan Atkinson and Miranda Richardson

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Jessica Knappett beautifully mimics a foghorn, Phil Wang makes ogres poignant despite his eye-catching costume and James Acaster finds various circles

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Satirical animation following the adventures of Stan, Cartman, Kenny and Kyle, who live in a town famed for its weird and inexplicable happenings. With the voices of Trey Parker and Matt Stone

programme.title: Jimmy Carr's Am I the A**hole?
programme.desc: Jimmy, GK Barry and Jamali Maddix scrutinise behaviour including a case of identity theft, a disagreement over pet goats and an influencer who lies to get out of family parties

programme.title: John Kearns: The Varnishing Days
programme.desc: Comedian John Kearns performs stand-up in front of a live audience

programme.title: Bruno v Tyson
programme.desc: [AD] The story of the boxing rivalry between Frank Bruno and Mike Tyson, spanning two epic fights marred by politics and volatile race relations, with the old foes coming together for a reunion

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys Christmas Special 2018
programme.desc: [AD] The festive season arrives once again in the Brown household, and Father Damian has organised a Christmas decoration contest to support the local football team. Agnes is keen to enter, especially as it might mean getting one over her old nemesis, Hillary Nicholson, but is soon distracted by her new 'wi-fi assistant' and quite what to do with it

programme.title: Man Up
programme.desc: While travelling across London to attend a party to celebrate her parents' 10th wedding anniversary, a thirtysomething single woman is mistaken for a recently divorced stranger's blind date, so decides to spend a chaotic evening with him. However, she has to face the consequences when he realises she is not his intended blind date. Romantic comedy, starring Lake Bell and Simon Pegg

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: [AD] Stan tries to infiltrate the Occupy movement, but the mission goes wrong and he is captured by radicals. He is soon returned home, but Hayley suspects that her father may have been brainwashed

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Poirot
programme.sub-title: The Adventure of the Egyptian Tomb
programme.desc: An archaeologist dies of a heart attack shortly after smashing the seal of an ancient Egyptian tomb, raising the spectre of the mummy's curse. The grieving widow summons the Belgian sleuth to unravel the mystery, but he can only smoke out the real villain by risking his own life. David Suchet stars, with Anna Cropper and Bill Bailey

programme.title: A Touch of Frost
programme.desc: [AD] The investigation of a burglary at a quarry turns into something far more serious when a security guard's badly beaten body is discovered at the scene of the crime. An autistic teenager is arrested for the murder, despite Inspector Frost's misgivings - a move which triggers a chain of tragic events culminating in a tense stand-off. Feature-length episode of the crime drama, starring David Jason, Bruce Alexander, Caroline Harker and Maurice Roeves

programme.title: Crime Scene Raw
programme.desc: When a Colorado grandfather vanishes, conflicting family stories lead police to uncover a dark betrayal beneath the concrete floor of his own basement

programme.title: Pink Floyd: P.U.L.S.E.
programme.desc: A 1994 concert by the band in which they performed their classic 1973 album The Dark Side of the Moon at Earl's Court during their Division Bell tour

programme.title: Secrets of the Hells Angels
programme.desc: Charles 'Peewee' Goldsmith was a kickboxing heavyweight who wanted nothing more than to be a Hells Angel. He survived two wars with rival biker gangs to become the President, only for the Angels to turn on him and his family

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: A pride of lions including young cats learning to hunt attacks a buffalo herd, but the raid leaves a cub dead, while three more stray into the territory of a rival pride

programme.title: Expedition X
programme.desc: [AD] Jessica Chobot and Phil Torres investigate a strange phenomenon that has been haunting Mammoth Cave in Kentucky for generations

programme.title: Date Me Right Now
programme.desc: Kimberley Cumberbatch takes participants into the street to meet potential dates, beginning with MGK

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: [AD] Double bill. The gang visits Barbados to hear Ross address a convention, but Chandler manages to destroy the only copy of his keynote speech. Joey and Rachel impersonate pharmacists to infiltrate a medical conference offering free drinks, while Mike arrives unexpectedly and proposes to Phoebe

programme.title: Skin A&E
programme.desc: [AD] Patient Georgia from South Wales returns to the clinic, she's hoping that Dr Emma will be able to remove some cysts from her legs. programme.desc: Game show, hosted by Ben Shephard, in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: Rose West & Myra Hindley: Their Untold Story with Trevor McDonald
programme.sub-title: Rose West & Myra Hindley: Their Untold Story with Trevor McDonald
programme.desc: [AD] The veteran journalist tells the extraordinary untold story of how the two most notorious women in British crime, Rose West and Myra Hindley, became lesbian lovers in jail. Former Category A prisoners, including reformed Mafia member Marisa Merico and ex-gangster Linda Calvey, tell Sir Trevor how Rose West revealed her murderous temper in prison, while former prison governor Veronica Bird, police officers and prison visitors describe how Hindley cleverly manipulated people in jail, even persuading a female guard to help her escape

programme.desc: A series visiting homes and buildings in various Welsh towns, starting with Blaenau Ffestiniog

programme.desc: [AD] David meets a model, and Natalie has second thoughts about what she wants after meeting a stuntman

programme.desc: Extreme sports star Xander Cage finds himself in trouble when his daredevil exploits land him behind bars. However, he is offered an intriguing escape route, courtesy of National Security Agent Augustus Gibbons - who thinks the adrenaline junkie is the perfect man to bring down a gang of international terrorists in Prague. Action adventure, starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson, Asia Argento, Marton Csokas and Michael Roof

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Creepy couple Morticia and Gomez find their unconventional life threatened by a man claiming to be a long-lost relative. When they welcome him with open arms, they fall prey to a plot that could cost them their ancestral home and the family fortune. Black comedy based on the 1960s TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd, Christina Ricci, Jimmy Workman and Carel Struycken

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Spooky couple Gomez and Morticia hire a nanny to look after their new baby son - and stop him suffering an early death at the hands of his jealous elder siblings. Romance soon blossoms between the new childminder and Uncle Fester, but he does not realise she is planning to kill him once she has got hold of the family fortune. Comedy sequel, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd, Christina Ricci and Joan Cusack

programme.title: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: [AD] A lonely boy befriends an alien who has been left stranded on Earth. The two develop a psychic connection as the boy helps the extraterrestrial to contact his own people and call for rescue. However, living on Earth starts to have a devastating effect on the visitor's health, and a government operative is determined to capture him for study. Steven Spielberg's sci-fi fantasy, starring Henry Thomas, Drew Barrymore, Dee Wallace and Peter Coyote

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Two brothers plan to pull off an ambitious heist during a Nascar race in North Carolina, but first they need the help of a convicted safe-cracker - who is currently doing time in prison. Steven Soderberg's crime caper, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver, Daniel Craig and Riley Keough

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: A former member of a singing trio, now running a hotel on a Greek island, is reunited with her old bandmates for her daughter's wedding - but is surprised when three of her old flames also show up unexpectedly. The three men have been invited by the bride, who wants to find out which one of them is her father. Musical comedy, with a soundtrack of Abba songs, starring Meryl Streep, Pierce Brosnan, Julie Walters, Colin Firth, Stellan Skarsgard and Amanda Seyfried

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: [AD] A Soviet submarine commander creates an international crisis by piloting his experimental nuclear vessel, which is invisible to sonar, toward the American coast. The US and Russian navies think he is planning to attack and set out to destroy the submarine, but a CIA analyst suspects he intends to defect to the West. Cold War thriller, based on Tom Clancy's novel, starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and James Earl Jones

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox

programme.title: Ferrari
programme.desc: [AD] During the summer of 1957, ex-racecar driver Enzo Ferrari is in crisis. Bankruptcy stalks the company he and his wife, Laura, built from nothing a decade earlier. Their tempestuous marriage struggles with the mourning for one son and the acknowledgement of another. Attempting to secure their survival, he rolls the dice on one race - 1,000 miles across Italy, the iconic Mille Miglia. Director Michael Mann's drama, starring Adam Driver and Jack O'Connell

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: A farmer is murdered by a hired hand, who flees into the wilderness. The dead man's strong-willed 14-year-old daughter is determined to bring the killer to justice, and recruits the aid of a hard-drinking, one-eyed marshal to help her track him down. The Coen brothers' Western based on Charles Portis' novel, with Jeff Bridges, Hailee Steinfeld, Matt Damon and Josh Brolin

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Film-makers venture deep into the Amazon jungle to document the lives of a remote tribe. However, the expedition is hijacked by a crazed hunter who plans to use them as bait to catch a gigantic killer snake. Adventure, starring Jennifer Lopez, Jon Voight, Ice Cube, Eric Stoltz and Jonathan Hyde

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: The world is thrown into uproar when 12 alien spaceships arrive at locations around the globe. As tensions rise between nations and fear of the arrivals grows, a recently bereaved linguist is recruited by the US army to find a way to communicate with the aliens and discover why they have come. Sci-fi drama, starring Amy Adams, Jeremy Renner and Forest Whitaker

programme.title: Star Trek Beyond
programme.desc: [AD] The USS Enterprise sets out on a rescue mission which turns out to be a deadly trap set by a mysterious warlord. The crew are left stranded on an unexplored planet, and join forces with a fugitive alien scavenger to find a way off the hostile world and prevent a terrible weapon being unleashed upon the galaxy. Sci-fi adventure, starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Idris Elba

She also adds some canned tuna, green olives, and boiled egg. She seasons the mixture with paprika, black pepper and her special ingredient, oregano. programme.title: xXx

Action adventure, starring Vin Diesel, Samuel L Jackson, Asia Argento, Marton Csokas and Michael Roof

programme.title: Demolition Man
programme.desc: Maverick cop John Spartan is frozen alive in 1996 and held in cryonic suspension for a crime he did not commit. Decades into the future, the dictator of a seemingly utopian city unleashes a criminal psychopath against his political enemy - but he proves impossible to control, forcing the authorities to revive Spartan to defeat him. Sci-fi thriller, with Sylvester Stallone, Wesley Snipes, Sandra Bullock and Nigel Hawthorne

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: Incarcerated Special Forces veteran John Rambo is offered the chance for freedom by former commander Colonel Trautman if he takes up the offer to return to the jungles of Vietnam on a life-or-death mission to rescue American PoWs. During the course of the operation, he develops strong feelings for his guide, a female freedom fighter - but tragedy strikes, leaving him more determined than ever to exact a bloody and explosive revenge. Action adventure sequel, starring Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna, Julia Nickson-Soul, Steven Berkoff, George Kee Cheung, Andy Wood and Martin Kove

programme.title: Rambo III

Action adventure sequel, starring Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna, Kurtwood Smith, Marc de Jonge and Sasson Gabai

programme.title: Just Friends

Romantic comedy, starring Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart, Anna Faris and Chris Klein

programme.title: Little Fockers

Comedy sequel, with Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro, Owen Wilson and Dustin Hoffman

programme.desc: [AD] A hard-working, small-town businessman comes to think his life has been a complete waste of time and tries to commit suicide.
